# TwoStack: WhatsApp AI Chatbot service (full details)

Page: https://twostack.lk/services/whatsapp-ai-chatbot
Provider: TwoStack, Colombo, Sri Lanka (https://twostack.lk)
Contact: twostacklk@gmail.com, WhatsApp +94 76 773 2288

## What it is

A custom AI chatbot built for a business's own WhatsApp number. It replies to customer messages automatically, using the business's real product, price, stock and order information.

## Key features

1. Instant replies 24/7 to questions about products, prices, delivery and opening hours.
2. Languages and styles: English, Sinhala, Tamil, Singlish (Sinhala typed in English letters) and Thanglish (Tamil typed in English letters). It replies in the language and style the customer used.
3. Voice notes: converts WhatsApp voice notes to text, understands the question and replies. Accuracy depends on audio quality, accent and language; tested on real customer voice notes.
4. Product photo matching: when a customer sends a product photo and asks if it is available, the chatbot compares it with the business product database. If it finds a close match it confirms availability with price and stock. If unsure it shows similar items or asks staff to check.
5. Product and order answers: checks real products, prices and orders; can take simple orders or pass them to staff.
6. Human handover: staff can take over any chat and see the full conversation.

## Who it suits

Online shops and retail stores, restaurants and cafes, salons and clinics, travel, education and property businesses in Sri Lanka.

## How it works

1. The customer sends text, a voice note or a photo to the business WhatsApp number (official WhatsApp Business Platform).
2. AI detects the language, transcribes voice notes, analyses photos and understands the request.
3. The chatbot checks business data (products, prices, stock, orders) and replies, or hands over to a person when unsure.

## Honest limitations

- No AI is perfect. The chatbot answers only from approved business information and hands over when it does not know.
- Meta (WhatsApp) charges its own fees for some message types, separate from TwoStack's build fee.
- Photo matching works best with clear product photos in the catalogue.
- Pricing is quoted per project in LKR after a short discovery chat.
